name: TranscriptionSession
description: A staff audio transcription recording session with settings, source timing, language context, custom transcription guidelines, and transcription progress

status.description: Recording lifecycle status: recording, completed, failed, or discarded

archive_status.description: Visibility state: ACTIVE or ARCHIVED. Missing legacy values are treated as ACTIVE.

source_label.description: Browser-provided or user-facing capture source label

language.description: Legacy language value kept for compatibility, containing a language name, code, Auto, or a comma-separated list

language_mode.description: Language handling mode: auto for provider detection or manual for saved language preferences

language_preferences.description: User-entered language names or ISO language codes used as manual transcription context

accent_hint.description: Optional user-provided accent or dialect context for transcript review, never an automatic classification

detected_languages.description: De-duplicated language values actually returned by the transcription provider across completed audio segments

speaker_scheme.description: Speaker labeling scheme: numbered, letters, or custom

timestamp_cadence.description: Automatic timestamp marks: speaker_change, two_minutes, both, manual, or none. Legacy 30s and 60s values remain readable for older sessions.

started_at.description: ISO timestamp when the first successful source capture started

ended_at.description: ISO timestamp when the complete session ended

duration_ms.description: Complete captured source timeline in milliseconds, including all leading and trailing silence

capture_started_at.description: ISO timestamp when the latest shared audio track became connected

capture_ended_at.description: ISO timestamp when the latest shared audio track stopped or the user finalized capture

meaningful_audio_started_ms.description: Full-session source position of the first sustained meaningful audio signal, separate from capture start

meaningful_audio_ended_ms.description: Full-session source position of the last meaningful audio signal before finalization, separate from capture end

leading_silence_ms.description: Silence duration from capture start to first sustained meaningful audio, when available

trailing_silence_ms.description: Silence duration from the last meaningful signal to final capture time, when available

audio_phase.description: Current source phase: waiting, active, quiet, or ended

audio_clock_source.description: Clock used for source timing: audio-context or best-effort script-processor fallback

last_speaker.description: Most recently used speaker label for new lines

custom_speakers.description: Custom speaker labels defined for this session

transcription_status.description: idle, processing, partial, completed, or failed

transcription_total_count.description: Uploaded segments in the transcription queue

transcription_pending_count.description: Uploaded segments waiting to be transcribed

transcription_failed_count.description: Segments whose latest transcription attempt failed

last_transcription_at.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent completed transcription

cleanup_at.description: ISO timestamp when cleanup was last applied

cleanup_summary.description: Bounded summary of the latest cleanup review

review_mode.description: Local review workflow mode: standard, pulsar_review, or custom_guidelines. Optional for older sessions, which use standard in the app.

input_mode.description: Session input mode: browser_capture for existing browser capture or audio_transcription for audio transcription input

session_mode.description: Independent session purpose: transcription or translation. Optional for older sessions, which use transcription in the app.

translation_source_language.description: Translation source language code, or auto for source-language detection. Optional until translation is selected.

translation_target_language.description: Translation target language code. Optional for older sessions, which use en as the safe app default.

custom_guideline_text.description: Processed transcription guideline text for this session, capped at 12,000 characters and used only in custom_guidelines mode

custom_guideline_source_label.description: Display-only label for the entered or uploaded guideline source; never a raw file URL

custom_guideline_status.description: Custom guideline state: empty, ready, conflict, or unsupported

custom_guideline_message.description: Safe readiness, conflict, or unsupported message for the saved custom guideline

custom_guideline_saved_at.description: ISO timestamp when the current processed custom guideline was saved

custom_guideline_locked_at.description: ISO timestamp when the custom guideline was frozen immediately before the first custom capture

custom_guideline_sources.description: Bounded safe provenance for the processed custom guideline sources. Each item contains only a display name, category, extracted text, status, message, and character count. Raw URLs and binary files are never stored.

name.description: Safe display name, capped by the app

category.description: Processed source category such as text, image, doc, docx, pdf, or zip entry

status.description: Source processing status: empty, ready, conflict, or unsupported

character_count.description: Character count of the extracted source text

pulsar_readiness.description: Local Pulsar Review readiness: not_started, in_progress, or ready. This never represents an external submission.

pulsar_qa_ran_at.description: ISO timestamp of the latest local Pulsar QA run, with no external QA upload or submission
